maintenance.safeEligible: Safe to run anytime — only acts on eligible bookings.
maintenance.warrantyItem1: Auto-escalates open claims where the professional missed the 5 business day response window
maintenance.warrantyItem2: Auto-closes resolved claims where the customer didn't confirm within 7 days
maintenance.rfqItem1: Auto-cancels accepted RFQs where the professional missed the quotation deadline, and emails both parties
maintenance.rfqItem2: Sends reminders to professionals who haven't submitted a quotation for 2+ working days
maintenance.rfqItem3: Flags quotations that have passed their validity date

maintenance.notificationsItem1: Sends 3-day nudges for RFQ, reschedule, refund, completion, and not-started bookings
maintenance.notificationsItem2: Review reminders at 10 and 20 days; unread chat after 24h
maintenance.notificationsItem3: ID expiry warnings within 30 days, then every 15 days
maintenance.autoAcceptAria: What does Run Completion Auto-Accept do?
maintenance.autoAcceptItem1: Auto-accepts professional completion requests after 10 days with no customer response
maintenance.autoAcceptItem2: Skips bookings with unpaid milestones or unpaid extra costs
